bug_fixed.root_cause: Line 847/876 in marketing_v2.py used results.get() without checking if results was None. The fetch_all_metrics function could return data where instagram/youtube keys exist but their values are not dicts, causing .get('success') to fail.
bug_fixed.fix: Added null-safety checks: (1) Handle None results by creating empty dict, (2) Check results exists and has valid platform data before accessing nested fields
